text_markup: Paid abilities on an {subtype:icebreaker} that modify that {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength implicitly have a duration of "for the remainder of the current encounter".
text_plain: Paid abilities on an icebreaker that modify that icebreaker's strength implicitly have a duration of "for the remainder of the current encounter".

examples.text_markup: {card:Corroder} has the ability "1[c]: +1 strength."" Since no duration is specified, this strength increase applies until the end of the current encounter.
examples.text_plain: Corroder has the ability "1{c}: +1 strength."" Since no duration is specified, this strength increase applies until the end of the current encounter.
